The fix is commit `0e06523` ("(fix) O3-6100: Prevent duplicate vitals saves (#3792)"). It changed one line in the chart: line 225 of the exported vitals-biometrics workspace, where `createOrUpdateVitalsAndBiometrics(` is now `return createOrUpdateVitalsAndBiometrics(`. Returning the promise lets the form keep "Save and close" disabled (`isSubmitting`, line 677) until the request finishes, so a second click can't submit again.

The commit also adds two tests in `vitals-biometrics-form.test.tsx`: one for a double-click while the request is pending (line 298), and one for retrying a failed save without losing the entered values.

Evidence, best first:

- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-biometrics-form/exported-vitals-biometrics-form.workspace.tsx:225` — the changed line, now `return createOrUpdateVitalsAndBiometrics(`.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-biometrics-form/exported-vitals-biometrics-form.workspace.tsx:676-677` — the Save button, disabled while `isSubmitting` is true.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-biometrics-form/vitals-biometrics-form.test.tsx:298-327` — the double-click regression test added by the fix.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-biometrics-form/vitals-biometrics-form.test.tsx:330-364` — the failed-save retry test added by the fix.
- Commit `0e06523b799319ec65716df66eafb32aef170b3c` (PR #3792).
- Earlier change `0599558fdb8e2c2ab990f688b8f019f1559187da` ("Derive unsaved changes from dirtyFields instead of isDirty in vitals form"), which touches the same form's save-button state. I did not open its diff, so it is only context.

I did not read the full test file bodies beyond the diff, and I ran no tests.
